title: Gemini and Antigravity Echo Bug - Unified Diff Parser Crash via Context Poisoning

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a detailed description of terminal UI artifacts (vertical borders '│' and bullet characters '•') being injected into the LLM context during file-reading and shell execution tools. Clear reproduction steps, expected behavior, and system details are included.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Modifying tool output sanitization and handling stdout/stderr buffers across core execution tools and text utilities requires multi-file updates in packages/core and adding unit tests to ensure UI artifacts are removed without corrupting genuine code contents.

summary.problem: Terminal-specific UI artifacts (such as vertical border lines '│' and bullet characters '•') are leaking into tool stdout when executing file-reading tools (ReadFile, Bash). This context poisoning causes LLMs to mirror these characters in generated code blocks and diffs, breaking unified diff and search/replace parsers.
summary.root_cause: Tool output returned from shell execution and file reads is directly appended to the conversation context without sanitizing visual terminal framing decorators and UI characters.
summary.context: File contents and tool outputs must be clean raw strings when appended to LLM context history to prevent the LLM from adopting visual formatting characters in code generation.

steps: In packages/core/src/utils/textUtils.ts, implement or update a sanitization function to strip terminal UI framing characters (vertical borders '│', bullet decorators '•', and ANSI control characters) from tool output strings.
In packages/core/src/tools/read-file.ts, pass the file content through the sanitization helper before constructing the LLM content payload.
In packages/core/src/services/shellExecutionService.ts, ensure captured stdout/stderr streams strip terminal UI artifacts prior to returning output to the model.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Tool outputs returned to the LLM context will be free of terminal UI borders and bullet characters, preserving raw file text so that LLM diff and code generation remain valid.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in packages/core/src/tools/read-file.test.ts that pass mock file content containing terminal UI border and bullet artifacts.
Verify that the executed tool result contains sanitized llmContent without '│' or '•' characters.
Run vitest on packages/core/src/tools/read-file.test.ts to ensure all tests pass.
